neighbours.label: The suffix 'ly' after a rarer adverb stem that splits off (impartial-ly, succinct-ly, curt-ly); common adverbs and other words in the same frames stay quiet
fire: He spoke succinctly at the hearing.
Judges must weigh claims impartially in court.
He wrote lucidly about the war.
The judge ruled impartially at dusk.
He replied curtly to the letter.
quiet: He spoke well at the hearing.
Judges must weigh claims fairly in court.
He wrote much about the war.
The judge ruled loudly at dusk.
He replied soon to the letter.
